{{Quote|We lost Volgh Squadron? How much of it?"<br />"All of it.|Tenel Ka and Han Solo|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>}}
'''Volgh Squadron''' served in the [[Hapan Royal Navy]] in [[44 ABY]]. The [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] consisted of [[Hapan]] [[Miy'til starfighter]]s, and they assisted the [[New Jedi Order]] during the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation]] from the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] after the [[Jedi academy|academy]] came under attack by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. During the evacuation, one [[Transport/Legends|transport]], [[Sharmok 718]], was boarded by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces, who loaded the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] with [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]]. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Hapan forces noticed the Sharmok was acting strangely, Volgh Squadron opened fire, setting off the baradium. The Sharmok was destroyed, along with the entire Volgh Squadron.
